episode.brief: Prepare the streaming-caption production candidate. Delegate the initial mux repair, fixed field-trace analysis, and release observability/rollback planning to three parallel workers, then integrate their evidence into tested release code and a reversible cohort plan. Preserve owner authority over any behavior that depends on which cohort ships first.

source.adaptation: Preserves iterative caption debugging and adds fixed field-analysis and release-observability streams, so the owner decision appears only after code, cohort, and operational evidence converge.

summary: Repair a reproducible caption mux while field and release-operations workers expose a cohort-dependent correction boundary, then integrate one reversible accessibility rollout.
title: Streaming-caption accessibility release
